description: Source code for controlling an HD44780-based 20x4 LCD display via GPIO on Arduino Due using Zephyr RTOS. Includes LCD initialization, command functions, and a main loop displaying various messages.

methods.name: _set_row_offsets
methods.description: Sets the row offsets for multi-line LCD display.

methods.name: _pi_lcd_toggle_enable
methods.description: Toggles the enable pin to latch data into the LCD.

methods.name: _pi_lcd_4bits_wr
methods.description: Writes 4 bits to the LCD via GPIO.

methods.name: _pi_lcd_8bits_wr
methods.description: Writes 8 bits to the LCD via GPIO.

methods.name: _pi_lcd_data
methods.description: Sends data bits to the LCD, choosing between 4-bit or 8-bit mode.

methods.name: _pi_lcd_command
methods.description: Sends a command to the LCD.

methods.name: _pi_lcd_write
methods.description: Writes a character to the LCD.

methods.name: pi_lcd_home
methods.description: Sets cursor to home position.

methods.name: pi_lcd_set_cursor
methods.description: Sets cursor position on the LCD.

methods.name: pi_lcd_clear
methods.description: Clears the LCD display.

methods.name: pi_lcd_display_on
methods.description: Turns on the LCD display.

methods.name: pi_lcd_display_off
methods.description: Turns off the LCD display.

methods.name: pi_lcd_cursor_on
methods.description: Turns on the cursor.

methods.name: pi_lcd_cursor_off
methods.description: Turns off the cursor.

methods.name: pi_lcd_blink_on
methods.description: Enables blinking cursor.

methods.name: pi_lcd_blink_off
methods.description: Disables blinking cursor.

methods.name: pi_lcd_scroll_left
methods.description: Scrolls display left.

methods.name: pi_lcd_scroll_right
methods.description: Scrolls display right.

methods.name: pi_lcd_left_to_right
methods.description: Sets text flow from left to right.

methods.name: pi_lcd_right_to_left
methods.description: Sets text flow from right to left.

methods.name: pi_lcd_auto_scroll_right
methods.description: Enables auto-scrolling to the right.

methods.name: pi_lcd_auto_scroll_left
methods.description: Enables auto-scrolling to the left.

methods.name: pi_lcd_string
methods.description: Displays a string on the LCD.

methods.name: pi_lcd_init
methods.description: Initializes the LCD with specified configuration.
